title: Dynamics 365 Finance: AI import of customer payment remittance advice for settlement
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned capability and target dates, and its feature-specific documentation gaps were confirmed. The licensing field understates the published Dynamics 365 Finance licensing baseline; it should name that baseline while retaining the uncertainty about this feature's additional requirements.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; summary; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Licensing is unknown because no licence specific to this feature has been published.
claims.quote: Customers must acquire and assign appropriate subscription licenses for their users in the Microsoft 365 admin center, following Microsoft's product terms.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Replace licensing.notes and the first sentence of Cost and licensing with: 'Dynamics 365 Finance users need appropriate subscription licences based on their assigned security roles. Licence requirements, meters and prices specific to this feature are not yet published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/sysadmin/stay-compliant-user-license-requirement. Replace the summary's last sentence with: 'Feature-specific controls, default and additional licensing requirements are not yet documented.' Do not infer that AI processing has no additional charge.
